authentication.owner_evidence: Login with Amazon OAuth consent, refresh and expiry recovery
authentication.notes: Hermes owns OAuth tokens; the model never receives them.

profiles.owner_evidence: NA/EU/FE Profile IDs, marketplace and currency
profiles.notes: Profile identity and region are mandatory inputs to every write.

sponsored_products.owner_evidence: Test Account or bounded canary plus independent read-back
sponsored_products.notes: Bounded mature optimization is autonomous; structural creation is separately approval-gated.

sponsored_brands.owner_evidence: Live schema, creative eligibility and independent read-back
sponsored_brands.notes: Reporting is supported; specialized creative/video/store decisions are not inferred.

sponsored_display.owner_evidence: Live audience/target schema and independent read-back
sponsored_display.notes: Reporting is supported; view-through, frequency and audience strategy remain product-specific acceptance work.

reporting.owner_evidence: Real submit, poll, GZIP download, schema and attribution backfill
reporting.notes: Persistent lifecycle, lineage, dedupe, maturity and freshness are controller-enforced.

marketing_stream.owner_evidence: Owner AWS delivery, dedupe and alert evidence
marketing_stream.notes: Used for monitoring and alerts, not as an unverified autonomous mutation source.

recommendations.owner_evidence: Live recommendation type, expected state and verifier read-back

budget.owner_evidence: Bounded canary and full attribution-window review
budget.notes: Percentage, cumulative daily exposure and task/day limits apply.

test_accounts.notes: Preferred proof surface for structural writes.

dsp_reporting.notes: DSP campaign and creative writes are outside the current autonomous strategy engine.

snapshots.owner_evidence: Real snapshot create, poll and download

amazon_marketing_cloud.owner_evidence: AMC entity/instance authorization and workflow evidence
amazon_marketing_cloud.notes: AMC workflow/audience mutations are not autonomous in this advertising control plane.

product_metadata.notes: May support planning; missing product facts are never invented.

budget_rules.owner_evidence: Live rule schema, exact exposure and read-back
budget_rules.notes: Complex rule creation is structural and approval-gated.

creative_assets.owner_evidence: Asset ownership, moderation and association evidence
creative_assets.notes: The system does not generate or silently replace creative assets.

sponsored_tv.owner_evidence: Live STV schema, creative eligibility and read-back
sponsored_tv.notes: Data remains product-separated; no generic SP heuristic is presented as an STV expert strategy.

partner_opportunities.notes: Opportunity data may inform explanation but does not bypass deterministic planning.

mcp_end_to_end_campaign.owner_evidence: Live workflow input/output schema and all resulting entity IDs
mcp_end_to_end_campaign.notes: Direct black-box invocation is blocked; the system builds equivalent atomic Campaign, Ad Group, Target/Keyword and Ad decisions.

mcp_locale_expansion.owner_evidence: Source/target Profile regions, localization constraints and exact atomic plan
mcp_locale_expansion.notes: Cross-locale workflows cannot bypass regional Profile isolation or approval.

billing_finance.notes: Billing, invoices, payment and financial mutations are outside scope.

account_administration.notes: Users, roles, permissions, invitations and account links cannot be approved.

irreversible_delete.notes: Delete/archive/remove operations are never autonomous or approval-enabled.
